new_asked_outcome.question: An in-play Kjasjavikalimm territory tile has two separate white economic converters, and its holder has enough pre-Economy inputs to pay for both. May the holder run both converters in that Economy, or must they choose only one converter for the tile?
new_asked_outcome.expected_answer: The holder may run both separate economic converters in that Economy; there is no one-converter-per-tile choice restriction.

required_facts.fact: Both separate economic converters on the territory tile may run during the same Economy when their inputs are available.

contextual_background: Each individual converter is still limited to one run, and the outputs are simultaneous. These are correct explanations, not additional omission criteria for this permission question.
source_references: Original Kjasjavikalimm front, Balkanized States’ Colonies illustration: YOU MAY RUN BOTH CONVERTERS.
Original booklet p7: each economic converter at most once per turn.
new_asked_outcome.novelty: Express positive permission to run both separate economic converters on one Kjas territory tile, distinct from repeating a single converter
